title: MMMem: Self-Improving Agents with Task-Aware Multimodal Experience Consolidation
abstract: arXiv:2611.30287v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: AI agents accumulate conversations, images, and documents through long-term interactions with users. Answering later questions often requires connecting evidence across these records, yet the resulting understanding is rarely retained, allowing mistakes to recur on related questions. Existing multimodal memory methods largely focus on storing and retrieving records, with limited mechanisms for learning from completed tasks and consolidating task-specific experience. We therefore propose MMMem, a task-aware multimodal memory framework that extracts and consolidates experience from completed tasks through four complementary strategies. First, source-linked multi-view memory organizes original text, images, and rendered pages alongside generated scene images that combine clues across records for retrieval. translated_title: MMMem：基于任务感知多模态经验整合的自改进智能体
translated_abstract: AI智能体通过与用户的长期交互积累了对话、图像和文档等记录。回答后续问题时往往需要跨这些记录连接证据，然而由此形成的理解很少被保留下来，导致错误在相关问题上反复出现。现有的多模态记忆方法主要集中于记录的存储与检索，在从已完成任务中学习并整合任务特定经验方面的机制较为有限。因此，我们提出了MMMem，这是一个任务感知的多模态记忆框架，通过四种互补策略从已完成的任务中提取并整合经验。首先，源链接的多视图记忆将原始文本、图像和渲染页面与生成的场景图像一同组织起来，其中场景图像融合了跨记录的线索以用于检索。其次，源生成的任务在两个层面支持知识对齐：预热阶段将源知识整合为与任务相关的经验……
tldr: 提出任务感知多模态记忆框架MMMem，通过四种互补策略从已完成任务中提取并整合经验，使AI智能体能够从历史交互中持续自我改进，避免在相关问题上重复犯错。
en_tdlr: MMMem is a task-aware multimodal memory framework that extracts and consolidates experience from completed tasks through four complementary strategies, enabling self-improving AI agents to learn from past interactions and avoid recurring mistakes on related questions.
